'''2014 Worlds Day 2 John Anderson LS Republic At War''' was the Light Side constructed list played by [[John Anderson]] at [[2014 World Championship]] (Day 2).

Deck name RAW. John Anderson / puck71, 2014 Worlds Day 2 8/23/14, 2013 form.

== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|Republic At War / Aggressive Negotiations|VB9-L-republicatwar-pre.gif}}
* '''Username:''' puck71
* '''Format:''' [[Legacy Open]]
* '''Stage:''' Day 2
